notes: Cyder uses an open cxcompatdb.so loaded by the original CrossOver ntdll hook. It owns current-process CompatDB arguments, DLL overrides, graphics backend validation and runtime prepend; Cyder no longer patches ntdll for CompatDB. The MapleStory stack is D3DMetal-neutral; MoltenVK feature-level validation applies only to the optional DXVK path. Graphics payloads are shipped separately. Every CX26 build includes the GE-Proton MapleStory launch fixes for CharPrevA/CharPrevExA NULL start (Wine bug 59926) and SPI_SETSTICKYKEYS/SPI_SETFILTERKEYS success stubs (Wine bug 59927). The release stack includes the MapleStory adaptive read-ahead cache, 512-slot capacity and WZ forward-scan read-ahead (F_RDADVISE, gated by CYDER_MAPLESTORY_READAHEAD=1, which Cyder sets together with the WZ cache). FAST_HIT, host page-cache prewarm, and H2 in-process hit-prewarm are not shipped after 2026-09 playtest／ablation (no material first-hit／feel benefit vs complexity). Ring, summary, timeline, cache-stats, section-map, mmap and Skill-pack／FAST_HIT／H2 probes remain development diagnostics. MoltenVK ships libMoltenVK-1.4.2.dylib only (Cyder014 drops the 1.2.10 real; 0.15.0 requires macOS 12+) with a wait-poll shim as libMoltenVK.dylib and libMoltenVK.real.dylib pointing at the real; the real keeps capability plus present patches (timeline-wait is shim-owned). Native-ddraw-path-v1 captures CYDER_DDRAW_PATH once at PE startup before imports, redirects only bare ddraw names to an absolute native DLL candidate, and preserves Wine native/builtin load-order policy. Mono-gs-last-error-v1 rewrites Unity Mono %gs:0x68 LastErrorValue reads (static code and the JIT emitter) on macOS to read through the real TEB. Private provider configuration is owned by the application and inherited through the normal process environment.
